head: c114b9c67f7bd6a2afc8a4394b4c372e2aea2e2d
scope: Routing identity, effective provider selection and response propagation in the task BFF diff.

checks.claim: Routes retain denied tile definitions without grant or admin metadata.
checks.evidence: buildEntities constructs routes from the original getDrawers rows before getAuthorizedDrawer/filterDrawersRaw. EntitlementRouting exposes only tileId/source/entityNames/features/applicationId.

checks.claim: Provider selection matches effective migration mode.
checks.evidence: TileAuthorizationServiceImpl includes all EMS3 scopes, including blank/invalid feature definitions, in controlled IDs outside EMS2_ONLY. EMS2_ONLY returns empty controlled IDs. Mapper and drawer marker consume the same set.

checks.claim: CES route identity preserves configured application/entity/feature fields without inventing a legacy role or team.
checks.evidence: EntitlementRouting uses existing TileEntitlementConfig normalization; invalid CES configuration retains source EMS3 and empty identity/scope. Full conflict definitions are not merged.

checks.claim: All entitlement-bearing response paths forward the same route catalog.
checks.evidence: v2/sso/login, v3/sso/login, v2/sso/validate and v2/sso/relogin all obtain routes from common buildEntities and assign entitlementRouting on ResponseOfAuthenticate.

checks.claim: Token-only and error responses do not overwrite refreshed routing state.
checks.evidence: Only entitlementRouting uses JsonInclude.NON_NULL. Extend/refreshtoken/logout/error response builders do not populate it; unrelated DTO fields retain their existing serialization.

checks.claim: The fixture correction preserves identity assertions and mapper behavior.
checks.evidence: AuthorizationResultMapperTest adds only UserData.itamId=51358 to the identity fixture; all assertions and production mapper bytes remain unchanged.

limits: Author self-review is not an independent BFF review.
Controller propagation is statically inspected; Spring controller integration is not executed.
Complete Maven remains blocked by missing private starters. No enterprise API calls, deployment or live parity verification.
